hook: They invented a whole new way of bowling to stop one man. It didn't work.
story: The man was Donald Bradman, an Australian cricketer who learned the game alone, hitting a golf ball with a single stump against a water tank. In cricket, a batting average above 50 makes you world class. Bradman was rewriting the record books, so England invented Bodyline: fast balls aimed at his body. It sparked a diplomatic crisis between two governments. It barely slowed him.
number: Cricket eventually changed its laws because of him. Direct attack bowling was outlawed. Still, nothing worked. In the entire history of the sport, no one else has finished a career above 62. Bradman finished at 99.94.
closer: In Australia, the national broadcaster's post office box, in every capital city, is 9994. Coincidence?
full_text: They invented a whole new way of bowling to stop one man. It didn't work. The man was Donald Bradman, an Australian cricketer who learned the game alone, hitting a golf ball with a single stump against a water tank. In cricket, a batting average above 50 makes you world class. Bradman was rewriting the record books, so England invented Bodyline: fast balls aimed at his body. It sparked a diplomatic crisis between two governments. It barely slowed him. Cricket eventually changed its laws because of him. Direct attack bowling was outlawed. Still, nothing worked. In the entire history of the sport, no one else has finished a career above 62. Bradman finished at 99.94. In Australia, the national broadcaster's post office box, in every capital city, is 9994. Coincidence?
